description: Full-scale reproduction of an early Farman pusher biplane, marked 3, standing outside the museum of the Gatchina aero-engine repair plant. The rest of the collection is aero-engines, from the VK-1A and AI-20K to the D-30F6 and RD-33, and holds no other airframe. Visits by arrangement. Data from the russianplanes.net museum register (museum 375).
museum_name: Gatchina Museum of the History of Aero-Engine Building and Repair
